summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the press release and Hong Kong poll-results announcement for its extraordinary general meeting held October 20, 2026 in Beijing. Shareholders duly passed the ordinary resolution authorizing, through a wholly owned subsidiary, a subscription for a limited partnership interest in Tianjin Lisi Xingshen Equity Investment Partnership (LP), with a RMB1.5 billion capital commitment, as set out in the September 24, 2026 EGM notice and circular. Total issued shares were 259,652,105, including 244,789,786 Class A shares. This is a routine EGM results notice approving an investment commitment, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
